title: PT1 — Earth: A Unique Planet — Comparative Model & Report
summary: Build a comparative model of Earth and another planet, then write a report explaining why Earth is uniquely suited for life.
instructions:
Your task is to build a comparative model of Earth alongside another planet in the Solar System, and write a report analyzing why Earth is uniquely capable of supporting life. You will:

  1. Choose one planet to compare with Earth: Venus, Mars, Mercury, or Jupiter.
  2. Build a physical or digital model of both planets, showing at least:
    • Relative size comparison
    • Atmosphere composition
    • Surface temperature
    • Distance from the Sun
    • Presence or absence of water
  3. Include a diagram or side-by-side chart comparing key features.
  4. Write a 2–3 page report explaining:
    • Earth's six key conditions for life (liquid water, suitable temperature, protective atmosphere, correct distance, magnetic field, energy source)
    • Which conditions your chosen planet lacks and why
    • Why these differences make Earth unique
  5. Conclude with a reflection on what makes Earth worth protecting.

Format: Submit as PDF report + photos of your model. Physical models may use clay, foam, cardboard, or recycled materials. Digital models may be made in Tinkercad, SketchUp, or Blender.
requirements: Comparative model (physical or digital) of Earth + one other planet
At least 5 comparison features (size, atmosphere, temperature, distance, water)
All six of Earth's conditions for life explained
Analysis of which conditions the other planet lacks
Personal reflection on why Earth is worth protecting
options: Physical model (clay, foam, cardboard, or recycled materials)
Digital 3D model (Tinkercad, SketchUp, Blender, or similar)

rubric.criterion: Scientific accuracy of comparison (size, atmosphere, temperature, distance, water)
Coverage of all six conditions for life on Earth
Depth and clarity of written report
